name: What is the process for starting a Studio ADU project with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a Studio ADU project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting a Studio ADU project with Hometelligent Inc. begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, budget, and property specifics. Following this, we conduct a site visit to assess feasibility and gather necessary information. Our team then develops preliminary designs and provides a detailed proposal. Upon agreement, we manage the entire permitting process, from drafting plans to submitting applications to your local jurisdiction (e.g., Alameda, Emeryville). The construction phase then commences, with regular updates and quality control checks. This comprehensive process provides clarity and ensures a smooth project from conception to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our Studio ADU process starts with a consultation and site visit, followed by design and a proposal. We then handle all permitting in cities like Alameda, leading to construction with regular updates.
